reviewer: Kimi Code recovery review subagent; actually viewed the full exact source, complete unchanged raw, full white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha comparison sheet and naiwa reference, inspected native-resolution raw detail regions, and verified the recorded evidence, source PNG, output, task, prompt, request, result and sheet SHA-256 values plus image metadata with read-only Python.

entries.positive_observation: The source's three-quarter head composition, source-compatible gaze and restrained single closed-mouth expression are retained on a compact yellow mascot with green-ringed solid black eyes and no human skin, nose or ears. Short gray-brown hair preserves the high receding hairline, side part, swept-back top, close-trimmed sides and short sideburns; distinct dark brows remain, with no glasses, headgear, moustache or beard added. The dark olive-green uniform retains red collar tabs with gold oakleaf embroidery, gold shoulder board/cords, one black-and-white neck cross, a gold breast eagle and the multicolored ribbon bar clipped by the lower crop. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a neck column, pinching, floating cloth or cream bib. The pale gray-beige painted backplate remains opaque across the full canvas with its soft mottling and vignette, and no frame, note, cutout or halo was added.
entries.alpha_decision: RGB art is approved, but production use still requires the frozen request's separate source-alpha BILINEAR restoration without changing RGB. The source is fully opaque RGBA with measured extrema [255, 255], and the unchanged raw is RGB with returned alpha extrema null. Full raw and white/cyan/source-alpha comparisons show no visible holes or backing loss. This is an approval for the source-compatible alpha-only step only; that repair was not performed and the raw is not marked production-ready.
entries.visible_limitations: Individual ribbon-bar cells and the smallest collar, shoulder and breast embroidery cannot be transcribed reliably at source scale. Approval covers the actually visible decoration types, counts and placements rather than claiming exact unreadable micro-detail; no rejection or repair decision is based on those tiny ambiguities.
